method: Actual E, WASD, Q, M, Escape inputs. Test hooks arrange locations, initial injury, and security reset after EMP. No direct service begin/update/completion/effect calls. Car damage comes from actual driving; mesh hashes compare raw Blender position buffers.

results.test: Fifteen real mounted services across five districts are present
Actual E performs medical scan, reports progress, restores health only on completion, then enforces cooldown
Actual walking interrupts a service without granting its effect
Actual E food order restores 25 health and activates timed neural recovery HUD
Actual Q drains neural energy and actual E at a utility terminal restores it
Actual directory interaction sets a persistent destination and full map shows services
Aligned projected apron keeps four ground brackets while its readable label avoids actual speed/E/service/status HUD; P hides and restores guidance
Actual ram dents Blender bodywork; actual E garage service restores its exact original vertices and integrity
Pausing cancels active service and resume cannot collect an unfinished outcome
